description: This file defines the 'Properties' class responsible for reading and processing document properties from Gnumeric spreadsheet XML data within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: Properties
classes.description: Class responsible for reading and parsing document properties from Gnumeric XML data into PhpSpreadsheet's spreadsheet properties.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Properties object with a Spreadsheet instance.

methods.name: docPropertiesOld
methods.description: Reads old format XML summary properties and sets corresponding document properties.

methods.name: docPropertiesDC
methods.description: Reads Dublin Core XML properties and sets corresponding document properties.

methods.name: docPropertiesMeta
methods.description: Reads meta XML properties and sets corresponding document properties.

methods.name: userDefinedProperties
methods.description: Handles user-defined XML properties, setting document properties based on attribute names.

methods.name: readProperties
methods.description: Main method that reads XML data, determines the format, and delegates to specific property parsing methods.
